newsitem.title: UK: Footballers cleared in soccer fixing trial.
newsitem.headline: Footballers cleared in soccer fixing trial.

text.p: Footballers John Fashanu and Hans Segers were found not guilty on Thursday of rigging matches in England's Premier Soccer League.
Fellow player Bruce Grobbelaar was also cleared of one charge of match-fixing but the jury had still not decided on a second charge against him.
Malaysian businessman Heng Suan Lim was also cleared on one count of plotting to fix matches.
The judge sent the jury home for the night and they will resume their final deliberations on the charge against Grobbelaar on Friday.

The verdicts came at the end of a retrial in one of Britain's most sensational cases involving top sportsmen. A trial of the four men earlier this year ended with the jury failing to reach any verdicts.
